question:

solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The top left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa8b084d49b6b050c048faa2b3ba32a789c457b0ca0ab41b75acad265b337d95.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f6ca11aa5ffb538f12154e0e67a3a82fd2e69c77f9de494fde0bd8e582bb450.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The top left corner element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c7ff88f44670bbf2ff26a1ac6f66db516e5e389f6696138fbe4654bea32eb7b.png]
